سُحَفْنِيَةٌ (in which the ن is augmentative, TA) A man having the head shaven; (IB, K, TA;) as also ↓ سُحَفَةٌ . (IB, TA.) ―
-b2- And with the article ال, What one has shaven off: thus it is sometimes a subst.; and sometimes, [i. e. in the former sense,] an epithet. (IB, TA.) ＝
-A2- Also A certain beast, or creeping thing: (Seer, TA:) [SM says,] I think it is the سُلَحْفِيَة [or tortoise]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
